{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
filtered_sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check if refunded orders are in the data
refunded_in_filtered = filtered_sales[filtered_sales['status'] == 'refunded']

# Check how many converted = 1 and status = 'completed'
completed_converted = filtered_sales[(filtered_sales['status'] == 'completed') & (filtered_sales['converted'] == 1)].shape[0]

# Check cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(filtered_sales['channel'], filtered_sales['customer_segment'])

# Check if the cross-tab shows imbalance
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(cross_tab)

# Check conversion rate by channel in the filtered data
email_converted = filtered_sales[filtered_sales['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_converted = filtered_sales[filtered_sales['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Compute difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
diff_rate = email_converted - paid_search_converted

# Return values
email_converted, paid_search_converted, diff_rate, cross_tab"}
